source.stem:
Which of the following options regarding Darwin’s theory of natural selection is incorrect ( )
A. All living things generally have strong reproductive capabilities
B. If living things want to survive, they must fight for survival in order to obtain food and space.
C. Variations produced by organisms must be conducive to adapting to the environment
D. Organisms that do not adapt to the environment will be eliminated

options.text: All living things generally have strong reproductive capabilities
If living things want to survive, they have to fight for food and space.
Variations produced by organisms must be conducive to adapting to the environment
Creatures that do not adapt to the environment will be eliminated

hinge.title: Decide that human digestion is the breakdown of complex food components into simpler forms along the alimentary canal from mouth to anus.
node_labels: Living systems: organisms, health and ecosystems

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Digestion joins simple food substances into complex substances the body can use.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: All digestion takes place in the stomach.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Food is fully digested once it no longer looks like the original food.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: Digestion is the absorption of nutrients into the blood.

intelligence.enrichment: Food enters the mouth and moves through the alimentary canal; digestion breaks complex food components such as carbohydrates, proteins, and fats into simpler forms that the body can use. complex food components enter alimentary canal -> digestive actions along the canal -> simpler forms become available to the body The learner correctly applies this rule: Food enters the mouth and moves through the alimentary canal; digestion breaks complex food components such as carbohydrates, proteins, and fats into simpler forms that the body can use. Digestion just means food moving through the stomach after eating.
